SITREP: A situation report: a short update about what a unit observes and is doing.
CONTACT: A report that an unfamiliar or opposing element has been observed.
FUP: Forming-up point: a named place used to organize before movement.
FLASH: Highest message precedence in this exercise; intended for immediate attention.
IMMEDIATE: Urgent message precedence in this exercise.
ROUTINE: Normal message precedence in this exercise.
source grade: A letter indicating the report source's assessed reliability in the scenario.
credibility: A scripted indicator describing confidence in the report source.
white cell: The instructor role that observes and directs the exercise.
net: A shared radio channel represented by the local message feed.
DTG: Date-time group: a compact way to label a message's time.
EMCON: Emissions control: a scenario setting for limiting transmissions.
